tailoring.headline: Product Owner Digital Commerce | Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Cloud & Solutions Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional digital commerce specialist with 5+ years of experience delivering and maintaining global enterprise e-commerce platforms across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record gathering business requirements, drafting user stories and acceptance criteria, mapping business processes, and leading solution design and UAT. Experienced bridging business and engineering teams in agile DevOps environments, coordinating API integrations, and steering end-to-end feature delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Business User and Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Commerce
cover_en.hook: HEINEKEN's ambition to become the most connected brewery through the newly established Commerce DevOps Hub in Kraków presents an exciting digital transformation journey. Bringing over 5 years of experience delivering and optimizing enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge business objectives with technical execution to drive measurable product value.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & Roadmap Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders to analyze business requirements, author user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: End-to-End Product Alignment & UAT
bullets.text: Mapped cross-functional business processes, defined acceptance criteria, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) to guarantee releases met business outcomes.

bullets.label: DevOps & E-Commerce Integration
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 within agile frameworks and steered complex data and API integrations across ERP, PIM, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Certified Domain Expertise
bullets.text: Hold certifications as both SAP Commerce Cloud Business User and Developer, leveraging deep functional and technical insights to optimize backlog refinement and cross-team delivery.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold an unrestricted work permit, and am currently serving my notice period with an earliest starting date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional experience can support the HEINEKEN Commerce DevOps Hub.

tailoring.why_company: HEINEKEN's vision to build the most connected brewery by establishing a dedicated Commerce DevOps Hub in Kraków represents the ideal intersection of digital innovation and modern agile delivery. I want to contribute my techno-functional commerce background to help shape high-impact, data-driven solutions for global markets.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to bring 5+ years of techno-functional digital commerce and SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to HEINEKEN's Commerce DevOps Hub, aligning business value with robust agile delivery.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Product Owner Digital Commerce opening at HEINEKEN Kraków. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce, techno-functional requirements engineering, and agile DevOps delivery at Rockwell and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss how I can add value to the Hub.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner Digital Commerce position within HEINEKEN's Commerce DevOps Hub.

With more than 5 years of experience bridging business requirements and technical delivery across enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to support your digital commerce roadmap.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
